// A RejectedOffer cannot be handed to Execute: only a VerifiedOffer can.
//
// want-compile-error: cannot use res.Rejected[0]
// want-compile-error: as core.VerifiedOffer value in argument to client.Execute
package main

import (
	"context"

	foraconnect "github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/sdk/go/connect"
	"github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/sdk/go/core"
)

func guard(client *foraconnect.Client, res core.Result) {
	_, _ = client.Execute(context.Background(), res.Rejected[0])
}

func main() { guard(nil, core.Result{}) }
